definitions.explanation: The number two. A fundamental counting number used throughout Japanese. Like other numbers, に combines with various counters and may change pronunciation in some combinations.

examples.english: Let's go together (the two of us).

examples.japanese: ⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二|に}つ⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{二|に}{月|がつ}→二月：00657_nigatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二|に}つ⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。⟦{一|ひと}つ→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{赤|あか}くて→赤い：00585_akai⟧、⟦{一|ひと}つ→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I bought two apples. One is red and one is green.
I have two children. The older one is a girl, and the younger one is a boy.

notes:
{二|に} is the Sino-Japanese reading for two. The native Japanese reading is ふた, used in specific counting forms.

PRONUNCIATION:
- に: standard reading, used with most counters
- ふた: native reading, used in {二|ふた}つ (two things) and {二|ふた}{人|り} (two people — special reading)

COUNTER COMBINATIONS:
- {二|に}⟦{人|にん}→人：00658_nin⟧ / {二|ふた}{人|り}: two people (ふたり is more common)
- {二|に}{冊|さつ}: two books
- {二|に}{台|だい}: two machines/vehicles
- {二|に}⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧: two long objects (にほん)
- {二|に}⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧: two hundred

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {二|に}⟦{度|ど}→度：noentry⟧と: never again
- {二|ふた}⟦{言|こと}→言：noentry⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧には: at every opportunity (lit. every second word)
- {二|に}⟦{者|しゃ}→者：noentry⟧⟦{択|たく}→択：noentry⟧⟦{一|いつ}→一：00705_ichi⟧: a choice between two options
